name: Melodee
intro: A four-track synth workstation with Prophet-5, DX7-style FM6, Casio CZ-1 and 808/909/SID drum tracks ready at power-on: turn ALGORITHM for a track, PRESETS for its sound, and play.

rows.what: Stage: all tracks with their sounds, patterns and levels.
Second HOME page: chord wheel of what you play.
Pick track 1-4, on every page.
Turn the pages of the open section; on HOME: tempo.
Off HOME: OCT+ enters or confirms, OCT- goes back.
Menu: colours, lights, autosave, USB audio and more.
Undo the last load, capture or edit; hold again for more.
Change the selected track's sound.
On HOME: the sound's 4 main knobs (Prophet: cutoff, reso, env, release).
On HOME: octave down (OCT+ up); both together: back to 0.
Arpeggiator mode; OFF switches it off.
Chord keys: one finger plays a chord in the key.
STRUM: spread each chord over a beat division.
The key's note becomes the root (KNOB 2 picks the scale).
Mute track 1-4 (white key 1-4: solo while held).
Track 1 level (KNOB 2-4: tracks 2-4).
All the engine's sound pages; EDIT again: map of sections.
Envelope pages (Prophet: filter, then amp); tap for next.
LFO and modulation pages; tap for next.
Temporary tweak, undone when LFO is let go (OCT+ keeps it).
On HOME: Init sound, Favourite, Sound designer, add/remove track.
MIXER: KNOB 1 level, KNOB 2 pan of the selected track.
Start / stop all tracks.
Arm the track; playing, it records from its next loop.
Arm and start recording in one go.
Capture: put what you just played into the pattern.
NOTES piano roll; tap again for PATTERN, TEMPO and more.
Go to pattern 1-8 (an empty one arms REC).
Select track 1-4.
PATTERNS: all tracks' 8 patterns; KNOB 1-4 pick them.
Tap tempo (F4).
The track's 3 insert slots plus SHARED; KNOB 2 picks the row.
Row's effect: Phaser, Width, Formant, Tape, Spit, Echo, Room, Reverb, Chorus.
Amount of the row's effect.
Open the slot: MIX, RATE, character, TONE.
Save the project to its slot (new: pick a slot).
Save the sound to a USER slot; name it, OCT+ writes.
PROJECT: projects A-D, the template, the power-on project.
Menu: KNOB 2 picks the row, KNOB 1 its value.
Clock source: INT, USB or TRS MIDI.
Concert pitch A4, 400-480 Hz (KNOB 4: fine TUNE).
ROUT: MIDI channels 1-4 play tracks 1-4; SEL: selected track.

tips: Power-on gives four tracks: IT'S A PROPHET 5, FM6 SOLID BASS, CZ-1 SYNTH.LEAD 1 and the 808 kit.
Projects save themselves after 5 s stopped and untouched once they have a slot; turn AUTOSAVE off in the HOME-held menu.
Tap GLO or SEL slowly for the next page: two quick taps lock its quick layer open (tap it again to close).
SEQ > TEMPO holds BPM, swing and QNT: OFF keeps your played timing, a division quantizes the new take.
Jam to song: switch patterns while playing, then on SEQ > SONG hold REC to turn the jam into the song.
Holding OCT- and OCT+ for 5 s while running enters update mode; let go during the countdown to cancel.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- alone while switching on: three key flashes, then reinstall from the web installer.
checked: v1.4.2-rc.1 hub tarball, firmware/src/panel.c: button enum B_FX B_SCL B_ENV ... in the FM-1 panel order; the second button (printed SEL) is Melodee's SCL. Encoders SELECT, ALGORITHM, PRESETS, KNOB 1-4. Hold OCT- + OCT+ at power-on = HARDWARE CALIBRATION.

ui_input.c btn_hold: HOME/REC/SAVE/EDIT/SEQ tap on release, hold 0.7 s. ui_input: HOME held = menu (again closes); HOME tapped on Stage toggles home_pg (ui_view.c chord wheel); else go_home. REC tap rec_tap, hold capture_take (SONG: ps_jam); REC held + PLAY rec_play; SAVE hold qsave (project_quick_save: own slot or PROJECT page), tap open_family(FAM_SAVE) = USER page; SAVE + REC quick save; EDIT hold undo_swap / step history, EDIT+OCT-/OCT+ undo/redo; SEQ hold = PATTERNS page, tap FAM_SEQ (NOTES first).

ui_input.c: ALGORITHM track_select on every page; SELECT page_scroll, on HOME select_turn(home_select()) default HS_BPM; PRESETS on HOME browse_turn (preset_go). OCT on Stage: octave -3..+3, both = 0; OCT+ held on Stage opens SHEET_STAGE (ui_popup.c: Init sound, Save as user, Favourite, Undo last load, Sound designer, Add track, Remove track); off Stage OCT- back / OCT+ enter (oct_nav).

ui.c stage_page: Prophet KNOB 1-4 = P5_CUTOFF, P5_RESONANCE, P5_ENV_FILTER, P5_RELEASE_AMP; CZ: wave, DCW, fine, vibrato depth; others ENGINES[e]->knob. momentary_take/restore: LFO held + knobs = temporary, OCT+ = KEPT.
engines.c TRK_DEF + project.c project_boot: power-on (no BOOT project) song.ntrk = 4: Prophet preset 1, FM6 10, CZ 52, DRUM 0 (comment: IT'S A PROPHET 5, FM6 SOLID BASS, CZ-1 SYNTH.LEAD 1, 808 KIT).

ui_layer.c: GLO layer black keys 1-4 mute T1-T4, white keys 1-4 solo while held, white 5 unmute all, white 8 (F4) tap tempo (INT clock only), KNOB 1-4 track levels, GLO+PLAY restart; SEL layer: any key = ROOT, KNOB 1-4 ROOT SCALE CHRD VOIC; double tap within 300 ms locks (LY_DTAP_MS).
ui_input.c PAT_KEY {0,2,4,6,7,9,11,12} = white keys 1-8 with SEQ held (empty: arms REC), TRK_KEY {1,3,5,8} = black keys 1-4 select tracks; SEQ held + SELECT chooses pattern.

params.c PAGES: CHORD = CHRD VOIC STRUM STROKE (N_STRUM OFF 1/8 .. 32T); ARP = MODE (OFF default) RATE OCT GATE; MIXER (tracks_edit) K1 LEVEL K2 PAN K4 MUTE; GLOBAL = A4 BUDGET CLK TUNE; SYSTEM = MIDI DRUM ROUT CPU (N_ROUTE CH1-4 SEL CH5-8 ...); N_FX list. ui_list.c: SCL family SCALES/MPC are list rows, so SEL cycles SCL list -> CHORD.

ui.c open_global: GLO taps MIXER -> GLOBAL -> SYSTEM -> WEIGHTS ...; open_family: ENV/LFO native pages for Prophet/FM6/CZ (P5 FLT ENV, P5 AMP ENV...), same button = next page; SAVE -> USER. ui_sections.c: EDIT on an EDIT page opens the section map.
ui_input.c fx_rack_enter / line 1110: FX rack KNOB 2 row, KNOB 1 effect, KNOB 4 amount, OCT+ opens slot page (FX 1 = MIX RATE CHAR TONE), last row SHARED.

ui_slots.c + ui_name.c: USER slot KNOB 1/2, OCT+ sheet on Save here, Save here -> NAME screen (overwrite asks first), OCT+ writes. PROJECT sheet Load / Save here / Rename / Boot / Erase. project.c autosave after 5 s stopped and untouched; ui_menu.c items incl. AUTOSAVE, USB INPUT, COLOR; menu KNOB 2 row, KNOB 1 value, OCT- closes.

main.c: OCT- + OCT+ held 5 s while running -> UBOOT countdown (from 2 s), letting go cancels. stub/stub_core.h + docs/RECOVERY.md: OCT- alone at power-on = rescue (retained MIDI update loader, three key flashes).
unsure: docs/RECORDING_PERFORMANCE.md says 'Holding REC opens the mixer'; the code (ui_input.c) runs Capture on a REC hold (SONG: jam to song). Sheet follows the code.
README says a new song starts with one track; the rc release notes and project.c power-on use four tracks. Sheet follows the code; the NEW song wizard (SAVE > PROJECT > NEW) roles were not described.
README says 'Hold SAVE to return to the sound before browsing'; in code SAVE held is the project quick save and OCT- in the browser goes back. Left out.
README's FX text says KNOB 1 picks the type on a slot page; code: type is KNOB 1 on the rack page, slot pages are MIX RATE CHAR TONE. Sheet follows the code.
REC + PLAY: if REC is held past 0.7 s before PLAY, Capture fires first. Not tried on hardware; nothing on this sheet was tried on hardware.
Manual link is the stable (1.4.1) illustrated manual; the nightly guide (https://keremimo.github.io/melodee/webapp/manual/nightly/) may describe the rc's strum and halve/double better.

Left out as too detailed: NOTES editor knobs, pattern dialog (hold pattern key: delete / copy / halve C# / double D#), SONG and MOTION pages, PRESETS browser page (KNOB 1 list, KNOB 3 fav, KNOB 4 engine), bulk presets, SysEx import, WEIGHTS, DRUM channel, hardware calibration (OCT- + OCT+ at power-on).
